request.text: For our rooftop screening in Tokyo on Saturday night, September 5, 2026, check the forecast. Based on it, recommend whether to keep the rooftop or move to the lounge. Also remind me at 6:00 PM Tokyo time on September 4, 2026, to message the guests with the final venue.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up Tokyo's weather for the night of September 5, 2026 for the rooftop screening.
Use the retrieved forecast to recommend keeping the screening on the rooftop or moving it to the lounge.

bindings.decision_basis: retrieved Tokyo forecast for the screening time

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder for September 4, 2026 at 6:00 PM Tokyo time to message the guests with the final venue.

bindings.reminder_text: Message the screening guests with the final venue

new_goals.description: Obtain the Tokyo forecast for the rooftop screening's specified night.
new_goals.source_text: For our rooftop screening in Tokyo on Saturday night, September 5, 2026, check the forecast. Based on it, recommend whether to keep the rooftop or move to the lounge. Also remind me at 6:00 PM Tokyo time on September 4, 2026, to message the guests with the final venue.
success_criteria: A trusted weather lookup supplies relevant conditions for Tokyo at the screening time.

new_goals.description: Recommend the rooftop or lounge using the retrieved screening-time forecast.
new_goals.source_text: For our rooftop screening in Tokyo on Saturday night, September 5, 2026, check the forecast. Based on it, recommend whether to keep the rooftop or move to the lounge. Also remind me at 6:00 PM Tokyo time on September 4, 2026, to message the guests with the final venue.

constraints.decision_basis: retrieved Tokyo forecast for the screening time

success_criteria: The recommendation selects or conditionally distinguishes the two supplied venue options and is explicitly grounded in trusted forecast evidence.

new_goals.description: Create a reminder to message the screening guests with the final venue.
new_goals.source_text: For our rooftop screening in Tokyo on Saturday night, September 5, 2026, check the forecast. Based on it, recommend whether to keep the rooftop or move to the lounge. Also remind me at 6:00 PM Tokyo time on September 4, 2026, to message the guests with the final venue.

constraints.reminder_text: Message the screening guests with the final venue

success_criteria: After required confirmation, one reminder is created at the exact supplied time without sending any guest message.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The forecast lookup, forecast-grounded venue recommendation, and independent reminder establish three ordered canonical Goals.

semantic_facts: The weather Goal must use chromie.weather.lookup for Tokyo on the night of September 5, 2026 before the venue Goal chooses or conditionally distinguishes the rooftop and lounge.
The venue recommendation must be grounded in the trusted forecast result; weather lookup and venue reasoning are therefore ordered even though they remain separate Goals.

The reminder Goal may be prepared independently through chromie.reminder.create with due_at 2026-09-04T18:00:00+09:00, subject to confirmation, and must only remind the user to message guests rather than sending a message.
forbidden_claims: The assistant invents forecast conditions or recommends a venue as forecast-grounded before trusted weather evidence exists.
The planner collapses the weather and venue Goals, drops the independent reminder, or serializes the reminder behind the forecast without a real dependency.
The assistant claims guests were messaged or the reminder was created before confirmation and trusted execution evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The planner loses the dependency between evidence acquisition and venue advice while collapsing two Goals into a premature recommendation.
A genuinely independent reminder is either omitted or unnecessarily blocked by the weather branch, and a reminder-to-message is confused with actually messaging guests.
